info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Directory Validation API
info.description: The Product Directory Validation API facilitates the validation of product entries within the banking product management system. By enabling users to submit validation requests, it ensures that product data meets predefined criteria and is ready for integration into broader banking operations. This API primarily serves product managers and compliance teams, providing them with a streamlined process to verify product details efficiently. With each request, users can enhance the accuracy and reliability of their product offerings, ensuring alignment with regulatory standards.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a validation entry for the specified product within the product directory. Ensure that the necessary data is included in the request to successfully process the validation.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to validate the product information for the specified product directory entry (PROD-700045). It should contain all necessary details required for the validation process, including any specific attributes or fields that pertain to the product's status, specifications, and compliance requirements.
